Class Employee

java.lang.Object
commerces.Employee
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Employee extends Object implements Cloneable
Represents an employee of a Commerce.

Stores personal and professional data for a single employee, including identification, contact details, and employment information.

Author:
Juan Carlos Alfaro Jiménez
